A whitespace-only strikethrough keeps the word separator

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>A<del> </del>B</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
